labels: A loose school blazer hangs away from the torso with visible air space at its side seams, while the hands and neck remain individually defined.; 헐렁한 교복 블레이저가 몸통에서 떨어지고 옆선에 공간이 보이며 손과 목의 윤곽은 따로 구분된다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: A loose school blazer hangs away from the torso with visible air space at its side seams, while the hands and neck remain individually defined.
